narrative.details:
I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
narrative.objectives: Sulhasa in southern Barrens wants you to clear out 7 Stormhide lizards and 7 Hecklefang Stalkers in the area so she can leave the tree safely.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for helping me out, Illbean. I'll let Camp Taurajo know you were able to rescue me. I'm so lucky you helped, I could have been stuck there all day!This is all I have to spare, but I hope it's useful to you.I'll be making my exit once I make the careful climb down.
